note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against draft-ietf-sidrops-aspa-verification Section 5.7 (rfc/drafts/draft-ietf-sidrops-aspa-verification.txt): "If the AS_PATH is determined to be Invalid, then the route SHOULD be considered ineligible for route selection (see Section 3) and MUST be kept in the Adj-RIB-In for potential future re-evaluation (see [RFC9324])." Verified changes since 6d0f3831a8 (eca6f68a41, ba0f3a3a7d, 3242d2dfb3, 1adbcc4337): fixtures added SourceOwner, SourceConnectionID, SourceReceipt, SourcePolicyEpoch and the pipe-ops argument on ExecuteCommand; no assertion was weakened. TestASPARetainedPathReplayRecovery (positive/negative) still verifies an Invalid ADD-PATH sibling retains exact AttrHex/NextHopHex/NLRIHex past validation timeout, stays excluded from normal replay, recovers in delta replay on later accept without another UPDATE, and emits explicit Withdraw on withdrawal without affecting the eligible sibling. TestASPARetentionReceiveRecovery (positive) and TestASPARetentionReplacementWithdrawal (negative) still prove complete received-byte retention, Loc-RIB and best-path exclusion while Invalid, recovery on later accept across early/pending/installed and typed/text modes, rejection of stale accepts, and non-resurrection after withdraw/session-down/origin-reject. Verdict stands: enforced.
